h1:
Krabi vs Koh Samui
which to choose?
intro: Torn between Krabi and Koh Samui? Here is an honest, side-by-side comparison so you can pick the one that fits your trip — or fit both in.

blocks.html: Short answer: Choose Krabi (Andaman) for limestone cliffs, 4-Islands and Phi Phi tours, and a base with many onward island options. Choose Koh Samui (Gulf) for a true island feel, beachfront resorts and a direct flight onto the island. The big difference is that their rainy seasons fall at different times.

blocks.text: Krabi vs Koh Samui at a glance

items: Pick Krabi if you love cliffs, varied island tours and a base for hopping onward
Pick Koh Samui if you want a true island, beachfront resorts and easy hops to Phangan/Tao
Check the season — May–Oct, Gulf-side Samui often beats Krabi for weather

faq.q: Krabi or Koh Samui — which is better?
faq.a: Krabi stands out for limestone cliffs and varied island tours, great for nature and adventure, while Samui is a true island with beachfront resorts and a relaxed mood, ideal for a proper island getaway.
They are on opposite coasts: Krabi (Andaman) is wettest around May–Oct, while Samui (Gulf) is wettest late in the year. If one is in its rainy season, choose the other for better weather.

faq.q: Is combining Krabi and Samui worth it?
faq.a: It is possible but they are on opposite coasts, needing a cross-peninsula drive or a connecting flight — worthwhile with several days. With limited time, focusing on one is better value.
